API Documentation
Static JSON API exposing every dump published on this site. No auth, no rate limit, CORS enabled — point any HTTP client at the files.
Base URL — in production, every path below is relative to the site root: https://deko661.github.io/hwidr-dump-site/api/manifest.json. Locally, files are next to the page (site/local/api/), so relative paths work over file:// too.

sdkContent.json is split into parts to stay under hosting file-size limits: fetch api/sdkContent.json.part0 … part4, JSON.parse each part (each is a valid {"Category/Name": "header"} object) and merge with Object.assign.
Examples
JavaScript — fetch the offsets and read GWorld
fetch('/api/offsets.json')
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => {
    const gw = data.namespaces.Offsets.GWorld;   // "0x1b1d12f8"
    console.log('GWorld =', gw);
  });
Python — load names and search
import json, urllib.request

names = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('<BASE_URL>/api/names.json'))
hits = [n for n in names if 'BP_' in n['name']]
print(len(hits), 'blueprint names')
C++ — consume the offsets header directly
// data.namespaces.Offsets maps 1:1 with the raw Offsets.hpp
#include <cstdint>

struct Offsets {
    uint32_t GWorld = 0x1b1d12f8; // from api/offsets.json
};
Field reference — shapes returned by each endpoint
names.json → [{"index": 0, "name": "None"}, ...]
objects.json → [{"index": 0, "type": "Class", "name": "/Script/Engine.Engine"}, ...]
typeCounts.json → {"Class": 12345, "Function": 6789, ...}
functions.json → {"ClassName": [{"name": "Foo", "flags": "exec=0x..."}, ...], ...}
offsets.json → {"namespaces": {"Offsets": {"GWorld": "0x..."}}, "rawOffsetsHpp": "..."}
decrypts.json → {"files": {"file.hpp": {"Namespace": [{"name": "X", "value": "0x...", "type": "uint32_t"}]}}, "rawHeaders": {...}}
sdk.json → {"Classes": ["AActor", ...], "Structs": [...], "Enums": [...]} (names only)
sdkContent.json* → {"Classes/AActor": "// Class Engine.Actor ...", ...} (split in 5 parts)
apex.json → {"mics": [[name, 0x..]...], "buttons": [...], "recvTables": {"table": [[field, 0x..]...]}, "convars": [...], "stats": {...}}
Memory offsets for UE4/UE5 internal structures. Base offsets for navigating the engine at runtime.

Decryption routines and keys for Fortnite's encrypted name/object tables.
Decrypts/Common.hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <functional>

namespace Decrypt {

using ReadFn = std::function<bool(uint64_t addr, void* buf, size_t size)>;

inline uint32_t Rol32(uint32_t x, uint32_t n)
{
    n &= 31;
    return n ? (x << n) | (x >> (32 - n)) : x;
}

inline uint64_t Rol64(uint64_t x, uint32_t n)
{
    n &= 63;
    return n ? (x << n) | (x >> (64 - n)) : x;
}

inline uint8_t Rol8(uint8_t x, uint32_t n)
{
    n &= 7;
    return n ? (uint8_t)((x << n) | (x >> (8 - n))) : x;
}

template<typename T>
inline T Read(const ReadFn& rd, uint64_t addr)
{
    T v{};
    rd(addr, &v, sizeof(T));
    return v;
}

inline bool PtrOk(uint64_t p)
{
    p &= ~1ull;
    return p >= 0x10000 && p < 0x00007FFFFFFFFFFFull;
}

}

Decrypts/GNames.hpp
#pragma once

#include <string>
#include "Common.hpp"

namespace Decrypt::GNames {

constexpr uint32_t PoolRva    = 0x1AF4CDC0;
constexpr uint32_t BlocksOff  = 0x10;
constexpr uint32_t UObjectNameOff = 0x20;

inline uint32_t Bswap32(uint32_t x)
{
    return (x << 24) | ((x << 8) & 0x00FF0000u) | ((x >> 8) & 0x0000FF00u) | (x >> 24);
}

inline uint32_t DecodeIndex(uint32_t enc)
{
    if (!enc)
        return 0;
    const uint32_t t = Bswap32((enc - 1u) ^ 0x6F1D17B8u) + 1u;
    return t ? t : 0x47E8E291u;
}

inline uint32_t Seed(uint32_t len)
{
    const uint32_t a = len * 0x2310u + 0x670073u;
    return ((a >> 23) | (len << 16)) ^ a;
}

inline uint32_t Rol32s(uint32_t x, uint32_t n)
{
    n &= 31;
    return n ? (x << n) | (x >> (32 - n)) : x;
}

inline void DecryptBytes(const uint8_t* in, uint8_t* out, uint32_t len, uint32_t seed)
{
    uint32_t st = seed;
    auto step = [&](uint32_t i) {
        out[i] = (uint8_t)(in[i] ^ (uint8_t)st ^ 0xB1u);
        const uint32_t a = st * 0x2310u + 0x670073u;
        st = (a >> 23) ^ Rol32s(st, 16) ^ a;
    };
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < len; i += 2)
        step(i);
    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < len; i += 2)
        step(i);
}

inline std::string GetName(const ReadFn& rd, uint64_t base, uint32_t id, int depth = 0)
{
    if (depth > 8)
        return {};
    const uint64_t chunk = Read<uint64_t>(rd, base + PoolRva + BlocksOff + (uint64_t)(id >> 16) * 8);
    if (!PtrOk(chunk))
        return {};
    const uint64_t entry = chunk + (uint64_t)(id & 0xFFFF) * 2;
    const uint16_t header = Read<uint16_t>(rd, entry);
    const uint32_t len = (header >> 6) ^ 0x117u;
    const bool wide = (header & 1) != 0;
    if (!len) {
        const uint32_t redir = DecodeIndex(Read<uint32_t>(rd, entry + 2));
        if (!redir || redir == id)
            return {};
        return GetName(rd, base, redir, depth + 1);
    }
    if (len > 1024)
        return {};
    const uint32_t bytes = wide ? len * 2 : len;
    uint8_t raw[2048], dec[2048];
    if (!rd(entry + 2, raw, bytes))
        return {};
    DecryptBytes(raw, dec, bytes, Seed(len));
    std::string s;
    if (wide) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 1 < bytes; i += 2) {
            const uint16_t c = (uint16_t)(dec[i] | (dec[i + 1] << 8));
            if (!c)
                break;
            s.push_back((c >= 32 && c < 127) ? (char)c : '?');
        }
    } else {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
            if (!dec[i])
                break;
            s.push_back((dec[i] >= 32 && dec[i] < 127) ? (char)dec[i] : '?');
        }
    }
    return s;
}

inline std::string GetObjectName(const ReadFn& rd, uint64_t base, uint64_t object)
{
    const uint32_t enc = Read<uint32_t>(rd, object + UObjectNameOff);
    return GetName(rd, base, DecodeIndex(enc));
}

}
Decrypts/GObjects.hpp
#pragma once

#include "Common.hpp"

namespace Decrypt::GObjects {

constexpr uint32_t ChunksRva   = 0x1B028040;
constexpr uint32_t NumRva      = 0x1B028054;
constexpr uint32_t ItemSize    = 0x18;
constexpr uint32_t ItemLow     = 0x10;
constexpr uint32_t UObjectIndexOff = 0x0C;

inline uint32_t Bswap32(uint32_t x)
{
    return (x << 24) | ((x << 8) & 0x00FF0000u) | ((x >> 8) & 0x0000FF00u) | (x >> 24);
}

inline uint64_t Bswap64(uint64_t x)
{
    return ((uint64_t)Bswap32((uint32_t)x) << 32) | Bswap32((uint32_t)(x >> 32));
}

inline uint64_t DecodeChunks(uint64_t enc)
{
    return Bswap64(enc ^ 0xAB47766400000000ull);
}

inline int32_t DecodeNum(uint32_t enc)
{
    return (int32_t)Bswap32(enc ^ 0x0AFED017u);
}

inline uint64_t DecodeItem(uint64_t packed, uint32_t enc32)
{
    if (packed & 0x1020000000000000ull)
        return 0;
    const uint32_t low = Bswap32(enc32 ^ 0x6D8533D2u);
    return ((packed & 0x3FFF00000000ull) | low) << 3;
}

inline uint32_t DecodeObjectIndex(uint32_t enc)
{
    return Bswap32(enc ^ 0xBF7C1ADDu);
}

struct Table {
    uint64_t chunks = 0;
    int32_t num = 0;
};

inline Table Load(const ReadFn& rd, uint64_t base)
{
    Table t;
    t.chunks = DecodeChunks(Read<uint64_t>(rd, base + ChunksRva));
    t.num = DecodeNum(Read<uint32_t>(rd, base + NumRva));
    return t;
}

inline uint64_t GetObject(const ReadFn& rd, const Table& t, int32_t index)
{
    if (index < 0 || index >= t.num || !PtrOk(t.chunks))
        return 0;
    const uint64_t chunk = Read<uint64_t>(rd, t.chunks + (uint64_t)(index >> 16) * 8);
    if (!PtrOk(chunk))
        return 0;
    const uint64_t item = chunk + (uint64_t)(index & 0xFFFF) * ItemSize;
    const uint64_t packed = Read<uint64_t>(rd, item);
    const uint32_t enc32 = Read<uint32_t>(rd, item + ItemLow);
    const uint64_t obj = DecodeItem(packed, enc32);
    if (!PtrOk(obj))
        return 0;
    if (DecodeObjectIndex(Read<uint32_t>(rd, obj + UObjectIndexOff)) != (uint32_t)index)
        return 0;
    return obj;
}

}
Decrypts/GWorld.hpp
#pragma once

#include "Common.hpp"

namespace Decrypt::GWorld {

constexpr uint32_t Rva = 0x1B096DE8;
constexpr uint32_t GetWorldVftIndexOff = 0x160;

inline uint64_t Bswap64(uint64_t x)
{
    const uint32_t lo = (uint32_t)x;
    const uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(x >> 32);
    const uint32_t slo = (lo << 24) | ((lo << 8) & 0x00FF0000u) | ((lo >> 8) & 0x0000FF00u) | (lo >> 24);
    const uint32_t shi = (hi << 24) | ((hi << 8) & 0x00FF0000u) | ((hi >> 8) & 0x0000FF00u) | (hi >> 24);
    return ((uint64_t)slo << 32) | shi;
}

inline uint64_t Decode(uint64_t enc)
{
    return Bswap64(enc ^ 0xAFB5C90D00000000ull);
}

inline uint64_t Get(const ReadFn& rd, uint64_t base)
{
    const uint64_t w = Decode(Read<uint64_t>(rd, base + Rva));
    return PtrOk(w) ? w : 0;
}

}
